segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some with peeling or bleeding patches, generally report it absorbs well and hydrates without heaviness; one reviewer with dry skin found it still felt dry afterward and preferred a thicker product.
segments.sensitive: The large majority of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea, contact dermatitis or severe allergies, report no irritation and reliable, comfortable moisture; one exception is a baby with mildly dry skin whose skin turned red, hot and blistered after four uses.
segments.mature: One reviewer with skin that has become thin and fragile with age reports this lotion is the only one that relieves the dryness and burning sensation she experiences.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report reliable, non-greasy hydration that lasts through the day, including for very dry or peeling skin; two reviewers, however, found the moisturizing effect too light on its own, with one saying her skin still felt dry afterward and preferring the thicker cream version.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report the lotion calms red, flaking skin from conditions like seborrheic dermatitis or psoriasis and stops recurring rashes tied to fragrance sensitivity; one reviewer's baby instead developed bright red, hot, peeling and blistering skin after several uses.
concerns.blemishes: Material is limited to a couple of reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone (one also rosacea-prone) and report the lotion keeps their skin clear without irritation, though neither details a specific before/after change in breakouts.

extraits.texte: My baby was struggling with mildly dry skin. At her 4 month wellness check we brought this up to her pediatrician. She recommended vanicream for use on her face, ears, and scalp. After 4 uses my babies skin went from kind of dry to bright red, hot to the touch, peeling, and blistering. The only change was the use of vanicream. We use tide free and clear laundry detergent and the same mild baby soap since she was born. I just wanted to get this out there and say if you think it's the vanicream, it is!
I purchased this for my dry skin after applying it still feels dry when using need something thicker it’s not bad but doesn’t work for my skin

extraits.titre: Lotion that sinks in and works!
extraits.texte: I got this yesterday and can already leave a glowing review Which is not a shock - vanicream is the best. Literally I use their face moisturizer and face cleanser and they work incredibly well for very fair sensitive skin prone to rosacea and acne They keep my skin clear and not dried or irritated. I have tried everything. As far as this lotion goes - it is a creamy consistency but absorbs so well. Your skin is not left sticky or tacky like many others. I have a Eucerin urea body lotion that leaves me feeling like I am covered in sweat and to be fair my skin would still be rough in spots. So it wasn’t worth it If you’re on the fence with this don’t be - vanicream is hands down one of the best companies for products that work well for sensitive skin and those who don’t respond well to fragrance. I’m happy I tried this so I can stop searching for a lotion that does exactly what I wanted which is meaning skin soft and hydrated but not feeling like you put anything on your skin. Not to mention their products are affordable and a little goes a long way. Buy it!

extraits.titre: Excellent skin lotion without unnecessary ingredients!
extraits.texte: I purchased this Vanicream moisturizing lotion after a recommendation by my dermatologist. I do have drawers full of skin products that I cannot use due to my extremely sensitive skin. I have very dry skin and psoriasis as well. I love this lotion because it absorbs well without feeling greasy. A little bit goes a long way and the pump is perfect for dispensing without a mess. There are only a few ingredients and it is fragrance free and does not contain all of the added fillers, that many other brands have. I also use some of their other products, but this lotion is my favorite. It is most definitely worth the price for a large bottle. I have purchased it several times and it always has consistent quality. I highly recommend this lotion.

extraits.titre: Remarkably Light & Non-Oily; No More Rashes
extraits.texte: After a lifetime of brutal rashes -- often in intimate places -- my dermatologist diagnosed me with contact dermatitis: Out with skin care products with "fragrance" and/or “parfum,” and in with the full Vanicream line, including this wonderfully light Moisturizing Lotion. It’s been life-changing. It pumps out fairly thin in both appearance and feel, and attractively so. No hint of scent, no sense of oil or grease, yet somehow, it truly does hydrate and moisturize. Most critically, no more rashes. I now also use the shampoo, conditioner, antiperspirant, and cleansing bar, and feel no less clean and presentable. My only cheats are ultra-rare uses of a scented deodorant when my confidence requires it; my sensitive skin forgives those rare uses and avoids punishing me with breakouts. For those with skin ailments -- eczema and psoriasis included -- eliminating scents and additives can be game-changing, and this lite lotion does its part at a great low-cost value. - (Was this "Helpful"? Cheers!)

I don’t know why I keep trying other moisturizers- I always keep going back to this one. A friend recommended this to me years ago, and since then it has always been my “fallback “ moisturizer when I try a new one and it goes awry. My most recent attempt was the moisturizer from The Ordinary which was okay, but I ultimately switched back to Vanicream. It is light but effective and you get a lot for the price. I have extremely sensitive, acne prone skin, and this does the job with no irritation. I do sometimes have to add another layer if my skin is feeling super dry or if I want that “night cream” feeling before bed but, after many trials and tribulations, I end up always coming back.

I was hesitant to buy this as I heard a lot of bad things about petrolatum product. To my surprise, it's very good. Calms my red, flaking skin due to seborrheic dermatitis and psoriasis. It's cheap too.
